title: Remove all “Models/Explore Models” sections and refocus site on Simulator + Learning

requirements.text: Completely remove the “Models” / “Explore Models” section from site navigation, including desktop and mobile navigation, and ensure no navigation item routes to “/models”.

quotes:
Completely delete the “Models” or “Explore Models” option from:

Navigation bar

acceptanceCriteria: Site header navigation contains no item labeled “Models” and does not link to “/models”.
Mobile sheet/drawer navigation contains no item labeled “Models” and does not link to “/models”.

requirements.text: Remove the “/models” route and page from the router and application code, including deleting/retiring the InteractiveModelsPage and ensuring the app compiles and runs without it.

quotes:
Update HTML, CSS, JavaScript/React code to remove:
Model-related components
Routes/pages for models

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/App.tsx` no longer imports or registers a route at path “/models”.
Navigating to “/models” does not show a models page (either route is removed and not present, or a not-found behavior occurs if the app has one).
Production build succeeds with no unused-import or missing-module errors related to removed models code.

requirements.text: Update the homepage to remove any “Explore Models” CTA/button and replace homepage primary actions with exactly: “Play Interactive Game”, “Start Learning”, and “View Case Studies”, while keeping the hero title “Game Theory for Strategic Business Decisions.”

quotes:
Homepage Update

Keep the title “Game Theory for Strategic Business Decisions.”

Replace any “Explore Models” button with:

Play Interactive Game

Start Learning

View Case Studies

acceptanceCriteria: Homepage hero title remains “Game Theory for Strategic Business Decisions”.
Homepage contains no button labeled “Explore Models”.
Homepage presents CTAs labeled exactly “Play Interactive Game”, “Start Learning”, and “View Case Studies”.
The three CTAs navigate to the Simulator (`/simulator`), Learning Resources (`/resources`), and Case Studies (`/case-studies`) respectively.
Homepage marketing/CTA copy contains zero uses of the word “Models” (including “Interactive Models”).

requirements.text: Remove all internal links, buttons, and references that send users to “/models” or mention “Models”, including the Case Studies page call-to-action and the footer quick links.

quotes:
Completely delete the “Models” or “Explore Models” option from:

Internal pages, links, and references

Ensure no text, heading, or code related to “Models” remains anywhere in the website.

acceptanceCriteria: Case Studies page contains no CTA/button text that includes “Model”/“Models” and does not navigate to “/models”.
Footer “Quick Links” contains no link to “/models” and no link text “Interactive Models”/“Models”.
No visible page headings include “Interactive Models” or “Models”.

requirements.text: Delete or retire all model-related React components under `frontend/src/components/models/**` (and any related imports), ensuring no “models” calculators remain in the codebase or bundled output and that the rest of the site (Simulator, About, Case Studies, Learning Resources, Contact/Feedback) continues to function.

quotes:
Update HTML, CSS, JavaScript/React code to remove:
Model-related components

acceptanceCriteria: There is no remaining feature/page that renders auction calculators, market entry “model” calculators, or bargaining “model” calculators from `frontend/src/components/models/**`.
The app builds successfully without any imports from `frontend/src/components/models/**`.
Simulator pages under `/simulator/*` still render and function normally.

requirements.text: Refocus site flow and user-facing labels to emphasize only: About Game Theory, Interactive Game Simulator, Case Studies, Learning Resources, and Contact/Feedback; remove or de-emphasize other top-level navigation items that conflict with this focus (e.g., remove “Quiz” from the primary navigation if present).

quotes:
Update the website flow to focus only on:

About Game Theory

Interactive Game Simulator

Case Studies

Learning Resources

Contact/Feedback

acceptanceCriteria: Primary navigation contains only the focused sections (Home optional) and does not include “Models”.
If “Quiz” is present in primary navigation, it is removed from the nav to match the requested focus.
All remaining navigation items route correctly with no broken links.

requirements.text: Audit and remove model-related learning assets and references, including any downloadable resource files or copy that explicitly centers “Interactive Models” (e.g., `frontend/public/assets/downloads/interactive-models-summaries.md`) so that the site has zero references to “Models”.

quotes:
Provide the revised full website structure and updated code with:

Zero references to “Models”

acceptanceCriteria: No static download/resource title or filename is presented to users that includes “models”/“Interactive Models”.
A text search across frontend user-facing copy yields zero occurrences of “Models” / “Model” used as a section name or CTA (excluding unrelated words if any, but the term should not appear in UI).

constraints: Frontend files in immutable paths must not be edited: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, and anything under `frontend/src/components/ui`.
nonGoals: Adding new simulator game types or changing simulator logic beyond what is necessary to remove Models references.
Backend changes (feedback/profile actor) unless required by removal work.
Introducing new authentication methods beyond Internet Identity.
